name: fortinet-mr-review-batch
description: Batch the full fortinet-mr-review flow (ingest → triage → fix → reply → cleanup) over N MRs via framework for_each + before. Two input modes: explicit mr_iids CSV, OR author/labels/limit filter resolved at run time by a setup node. Replaces v0.2.0 (iid-only) and v0.1.x (HTTP child-dispatch).
author: forge
